label: Present-receipt controls checked
description: The inertial history with past-tense receipt satisfies the onset reading and correlativity and falsifies the present-tense reading and 40a97664; with standing receipt it satisfies the present-tense and onset readings and falsifies correlativity and 40a97664; the sustaining history with no receipt satisfies 40a97664 and falsifies the present-tense reading; each premise of the onset derivation is needed in one interpretation; all premises and 40a97664 hold together in one interpretation. A finite countermodel shows a premise is needed in that interpretation, not that it is false. Model claims concern these interpretations only.
